mmlore: With blade from aeons past, swiftly,
they shall breathe their last.
Dragonbone Dagger.name: Dragonbone Dagger
Dragonbone Dagger.lore:
With blade from aeons past, swiftly,
they shall breathe their last.

mmlore: The axe screams at every touch,
a rage, crazed by hunger.
Fleshbreaker.name: Fleshbreaker
Fleshbreaker.lore:
The axe screams at every touch,
a rage, crazed by hunger.

mmlore: Such battle fierce, the storm did
rage, then swift the axe did fall.
Lord Alric stumbled from the rift,
for he had slain them all.
Frost Giant's Crusher.name: Frost Giant's Crusher
Frost Giant's Crusher.lore:
Such battle fierce, the storm did
rage, then swift the axe did fall.
Lord Alric stumbled from the rift,
for he had slain them all.

mmlore: So out set Alric, brave and strong,
his steel clutched tight in hand. The
icy chill would gnaw his bones, but
blood was his demand.
Frost Giant's Greatsword.name: Frost Giant's Greatsword
Frost Giant's Greatsword.lore:
So out set Alric, brave and strong,
his steel clutched tight in hand. The
icy chill would gnaw his bones, but
blood was his demand.

mmlore: When work was done a rest deserved,
so slumber did these gods. But soon
the waking ones did rise and for
their power clawed.
Frost Giant's Crescent.name: Frost Giant's Crescent
Frost Giant's Crescent.lore:
When work was done a rest deserved,
so slumber did these gods. But soon
the waking ones did rise and for
their power clawed.

mmlore: In time before the time you know,
the Giants shaped these lands. Shaped
from the mantle, ocean floor, turned
then to ice and sand.
Frost Giant's Staff.name: Frost Giant's Staff
Frost Giant's Staff.lore:
In time before the time you know,
the Giants shaped these lands. Shaped
from the mantle, ocean floor, turned
then to ice and sand.

mmlore: The truth of Al Malakut has at last been
told. Now you hold its power.
Soul of Ishnir.name: Soul of Ishnir
Soul of Ishnir.lore:
The truth of Al Malakut has at last been
told. Now you hold its power.

mmlore: Those who walk the path of power
will be the ones to do what is necessary
before what is easy.
Ire of the Gods.name: Ire of the Gods
Ire of the Gods.lore:
Those who walk the path of power
will be the ones to do what is necessary
before what is easy.

mmlore: As you place this frozen crown on
your head, you feel the weight of
an ancient violence and the hum
of an even older song.
Frost Giant's Crown.name: Frost Giant's Crown
Frost Giant's Crown.lore:
As you place this frozen crown on
your head, you feel the weight of
an ancient violence and the hum
of an even older song.

mmlore: Sculpt the earth with a single swing.
The Earthshaker.name: The Earthshaker
The Earthshaker.lore: Sculpt the earth with a single swing.

mmlore: Gaze into the depths of the
mirror and you will see only
your darkest desires.
Aurora Mirror (mainhand).name: Aurora Mirror
Aurora Mirror (mainhand).lore:
Gaze into the depths of the
mirror and you will see only
your darkest desires.

mmlore: He thought that nothing could touch
him, even as his world disintegrated
before his eyes.
Salazar's Greed.name: Salazar's Greed
Salazar's Greed.lore:
He thought that nothing could touch
him, even as his world disintegrated
before his eyes.

mmlore: Now as the mist grew dark and deep
and the fog grew piercing eyes,
the black ship sailed through blackest night
and aboard they cried goodbyes.
Mist's Wake.name: Mist's Wake
Mist's Wake.lore:
Now as the mist grew dark and deep
and the fog grew piercing eyes,
the black ship sailed through blackest night
and aboard they cried goodbyes.

mmlore: When Lilac and Rose restored as one,
the Chains were born in unity.
Chains of Entropy.name: Chains of Entropy
Chains of Entropy.lore:
When Lilac and Rose restored as one,
the Chains were born in unity.

mmlore: When rage, hope, greed, and
courage intertwine in harmony, it
grants peace to everything it meets.
Ardent Convergence.name: Ardent Convergence
Ardent Convergence.lore:
When rage, hope, greed, and
courage intertwine in harmony, it
grants peace to everything it meets.

mmlore: Oh Silver ones, bestow onto
us your gift. Grant us blood
and flame and we will hold
your seal eternal.
Silverthread Raiment.name: Silverthread Raiment
Silverthread Raiment.lore:
Oh Silver ones, bestow onto
us your gift. Grant us blood
and flame and we will hold
your seal eternal.

mmlore: This world is tainted by power that
no man should hold. I alone will
bear these sins. I alone can end
them. Whatever it takes.
Sword of the Exiled.name: Sword of the Exiled
Sword of the Exiled.lore:
This world is tainted by power that
no man should hold. I alone will
bear these sins. I alone can end
them. Whatever it takes.

mmlore: Once you meet its gaze, it will
not rest until your defeat.
Phoenix's Gaze.name: Phoenix's Gaze
Phoenix's Gaze.lore:
Once you meet its gaze, it will
not rest until your defeat.

mmlore: A conduit of angel power.
Guardian Angel.name: Guardian Angel

mmlore: The power of the infernal slowly
demands more and more, with diminishing
returns...
Pact of Punishment.name: Pact of Punishment
Pact of Punishment.lore:
The power of the infernal slowly
demands more and more, with diminishing
returns...

mmlore: The skies trembled and the ground quaked,
but the vanguard pushed on.
Blitzkrieg.name: Blitzkrieg
Blitzkrieg.lore:
The skies trembled and the ground quaked,
but the vanguard pushed on.

mmlore: Attuned to the power of Light.
Brings forth light that will pierce
through the darkness around you.
<gray>Activated by <key:key.use>
<gray>while in the mainhand.
Charges : <#4ac2e5>∞
Cooldown : <#4ac2e5>None
Tesseract of Light (u).name: Tesseract of Light (u)
Tesseract of Light (u).lore:
Attuned to the power of Light.
Brings forth light that will pierce
through the darkness around you.
Activated by 
while in the mainhand.
Charges : ∞
Cooldown : None

mmlore: Saia's Grace had claimed another mind,
forever imprisoned beneath the ashes
and the clay. Beneath the sands and
stones of Ishnir.
Flame of Fallen Grace.name: Flame of Fallen Grace
Flame of Fallen Grace.lore:
Saia's Grace had claimed another mind,
forever imprisoned beneath the ashes
and the clay. Beneath the sands and
stones of Ishnir.

mmlore: The weapon is cursed. A presence looms
upon it, clinging to the song of those
who are to soon sing their last hymn.
Haunting Hymn.name: Haunting Hymn
Haunting Hymn.lore:
The weapon is cursed. A presence looms
upon it, clinging to the song of those
who are to soon sing their last hymn.

mmlore: These boots cling tightly to your feet
as soon as you pull them on. Weren't
these much larger moments ago?
Colossal Sabatons.name: Colossal Sabatons
Colossal Sabatons.lore:
These boots cling tightly to your feet
as soon as you pull them on. Weren't
these much larger moments ago?

mmlore: Traces of the Void drip from the soles
of these strange boots, a reminder of
the cost to travel the space between.
Riftborn Walkers.name: Riftborn Walkers
Riftborn Walkers.lore:
Traces of the Void drip from the soles
of these strange boots, a reminder of
the cost to travel the space between.

mmlore: Inspiration spurs you as you draw...
To be greater, is to seek within and
understand that you are lesser.
Enlightenment.name: Enlightenment
Enlightenment.lore:
Inspiration spurs you as you draw...
To be greater, is to seek within and
understand that you are lesser.

mmlore: A wicked garb, cursed by darkness
<dark_gray>and claimed by pure evil.
Shroud of Dread.name: Shroud of Dread
Shroud of Dread.lore:
A wicked garb, cursed by darkness
and claimed by pure evil.

mmlore: It's hard to tell what the... thing in your hands is.
It is merely a twisted echo of whatever it once was.
Specter's Visage.name: Specter's Visage
Specter's Visage.lore:
It's hard to tell what the... thing in your hands is.
It is merely a twisted echo of whatever it once was.

mmlore: A knight should protect...
for our codex commands it!
The Knight's Pledge.name: The Knight's Pledge
The Knight's Pledge.lore:
A knight should protect...
for our codex commands it!

mmlore: The best of armor is tempered
not by the forge, but by the harsh
extremes of nature.
Leviathan Scales.name: Leviathan Scales
Leviathan Scales.lore:
The best of armor is tempered
not by the forge, but by the harsh
extremes of nature.

mmlore: The outer layer of these strange greaves
have crystallized. Tougher than most metals...
Yet like the stars, majestic and graceful.
Ad Astra.name: Ad Astra
Ad Astra.lore:
The outer layer of these strange greaves
have crystallized. Tougher than most metals...
Yet like the stars, majestic and graceful.

mmlore: Good may not always triumph, but I'll take
the company of knights and heroes to that
of knaves and scoundrels any day.
Tournament Longsword.name: Tournament Longsword
Tournament Longsword.lore:
Good may not always triumph, but I'll take
the company of knights and heroes to that
of knaves and scoundrels any day.

mmlore: Smoke issues from the charred wood while
sparks rage across its face.
Infernal Aegis.name: Infernal Aegis
Infernal Aegis.lore:
Smoke issues from the charred wood while
sparks rage across its face.

mmlore: A shield? Best not to rely on one. After
all, no one can parry a dragon's tail
or a manticore's claws.
Studded Gauntlet.name: Studded Gauntlet
Studded Gauntlet.lore:
A shield? Best not to rely on one. After
all, no one can parry a dragon's tail
or a manticore's claws.

mmlore: As you pull the blade out from the behemoth's
chest, a malice presides upon it. It barely holds
its shape as it mutates into something horrible.
Twisted Splinter.name: Twisted Splinter
Twisted Splinter.lore:
As you pull the blade out from the behemoth's
chest, a malice presides upon it. It barely holds
its shape as it mutates into something horrible.

mmlore: The scales seem to fuse to your feet
as you drift deeper into darkness.
Drifting Scales.name: Drifting Scales
Drifting Scales.lore:
The scales seem to fuse to your feet
as you drift deeper into darkness.

mmlore: Above the waves the Mist sails endlessly.
Beneath them its crashing wake is felt.
Lieutenant's Storm.name: Lieutenant's Storm
Lieutenant's Storm.lore:
Above the waves the Mist sails endlessly.
Beneath them its crashing wake is felt.

mmlore: The bow's thorns hum with magical
prowess, while the string glows
with luminous intent.
Wildthorn Crescent.name: Wildthorn Crescent
Wildthorn Crescent.lore:
The bow's thorns hum with magical
prowess, while the string glows
with luminous intent.

mmlore: The eyes seem to sink further into the depths
around you. Distance is held.
Veil's Horizon.name: Veil's Horizon
Veil's Horizon.lore:
The eyes seem to sink further into the depths
around you. Distance is held.

mmlore: With every attack you feel it shift
and blow around your body - first
with a furious tempest, then a soft
spring breeze.
Shroud of Sea and Sky.name: Shroud of Sea and Sky
Shroud of Sea and Sky.lore:
With every attack you feel it shift
and blow around your body - first
with a furious tempest, then a soft
spring breeze.

mmlore: Reality moves differently in the darkest
of depths. Sometimes it twists into
something... else.
K'x'aehdd.name: K'x'aehdd
K'x'aehdd.lore:
Reality moves differently in the darkest
of depths. Sometimes it twists into
something... else.

mmlore: Reflected in its gem you see a massive
tree, reaching toward the heavens.
Rootweave Diadem.name: Rootweave Diadem
Rootweave Diadem.lore:
Reflected in its gem you see a massive
tree, reaching toward the heavens.

mmlore: A rhythmic flow stirs beneath your
feet. Nearby, you hear a breathy sigh
from the sand and silt.
Earth's Maw.name: Earth's Maw
Earth's Maw.lore:
A rhythmic flow stirs beneath your
feet. Nearby, you hear a breathy sigh
from the sand and silt.

mmlore: Adapting to the crushing depths,
each step alters their form, concealing
you from watchful eyes. Are these
chains... alive?
Cephalopodic Chains.name: Cephalopodic Chains
Cephalopodic Chains.lore:
Adapting to the crushing depths,
each step alters their form, concealing
you from watchful eyes. Are these
chains... alive?

mmlore: Golden runes scar the greaves, glowing
with a heat eternal. A bittersweet
aura hangs quiet in the heart of
this inferno.
Pyrrhic Greaves.name: Pyrrhic Greaves
Pyrrhic Greaves.lore:
Golden runes scar the greaves, glowing
with a heat eternal. A bittersweet
aura hangs quiet in the heart of
this inferno.

mmlore: The lost souls swirling in these waters
are familiar. They too were tempted
by those beyond the Veil.
Seeker's Pursuit.name: Seeker's Pursuit
Seeker's Pursuit.lore:
The lost souls swirling in these waters
are familiar. They too were tempted
by those beyond the Veil.

mmlore: The very skin of the bag is alive with
a corrupting alchemy. Your materials within
are infused with a twisting power from Below.
Veilcoral Bag.name: Veilcoral Bag
Veilcoral Bag.lore:
The very skin of the bag is alive with
a corrupting alchemy. Your materials within
are infused with a twisting power from Below.

mmlore: Magical energy whirs around the
blade, forming a hurricane with
which to smite your foes.
Energized Maelstrom.name: Energized Maelstrom
Energized Maelstrom.lore:
Magical energy whirs around the
blade, forming a hurricane with
which to smite your foes.

mmlore: Lights hand in all the spaces above, earth
quakes in the ground below. All around,
the currents scream eternal.
Angler's Lure.name: Angler's Lure
Angler's Lure.lore:
Lights hand in all the spaces above, earth
quakes in the ground below. All around,
the currents scream eternal.

mmlore: The scalding waves pull all deeper. It
was a fate that returned those curious
souls to the primordial sea.
Mu'xro'hkr.name: Mu'xro'hkr
Mu'xro'hkr.lore:
The scalding waves pull all deeper. It
was a fate that returned those curious
souls to the primordial sea.

mmlore: Within rebirth, that seed of temptation
bloomed. Hedera would turn towards the
sea, enchanted by a new voice...
Dryadic Temptation.name: Dryadic Temptation
Dryadic Temptation.lore:
Within rebirth, that seed of temptation
bloomed. Hedera would turn towards the
sea, enchanted by a new voice...

mmlore: Hunger courses through the veins
of this plantlike pick. Turn it
to your benefit - or else.
Dionaeas Graft.name: Dionaeas Graft
Dionaeas Graft.lore:
Hunger courses through the veins
of this plantlike pick. Turn it
to your benefit - or else.

mmlore: Hydrothermal calcification formed an explosive
mineral used here, carefully affixed, but
not so carefully swung.
Phlogiston Fissure.name: Phlogiston Fissure
Phlogiston Fissure.lore:
Hydrothermal calcification formed an explosive
mineral used here, carefully affixed, but
not so carefully swung.

mmlore: The coral from which it is crafted
burns with an intensity found only
in the deepest trenches.
Firecoral Lance.name: Firecoral Lance
Firecoral Lance.lore:
The coral from which it is crafted
burns with an intensity found only
in the deepest trenches.

mmlore: One must be swift on their feet to safely
navigate the Dunes of Ishnir.
Dune Raider's Treads.name: Dune Raider's Treads
Dune Raider's Treads.lore:
One must be swift on their feet to safely
navigate the Dunes of Ishnir.

mmlore: You stand on the shoulders of those
who came before you. Their experiences
now carve the path you are destined
to travel.
Sailwoven Sandals.name: Sailwoven Sandals
Sailwoven Sandals.lore:
You stand on the shoulders of those
who came before you. Their experiences
now carve the path you are destined
to travel.

mmlore: A blessing of the divine.
A gift from a father.
A tool for a Paladin.
Seraphic Hauberk.name: Seraphic Hauberk
Seraphic Hauberk.lore:
A blessing of the divine.
A gift from a father.
A tool for a Paladin.

mmlore: The runes inscribed upon the metal
emit a powerful aura. Let them guide
you to a brighter future.
Seer's Runeplate.name: Seer's Runeplate
Seer's Runeplate.lore:
The runes inscribed upon the metal
emit a powerful aura. Let them guide
you to a brighter future.

mmlore: When you've been all over the
Celsian Isles, you need to be
prepared for anything.
Bounty Hunter's Gambeson.name: Bounty Hunter's Gambeson
Bounty Hunter's Gambeson.lore:
When you've been all over the
Celsian Isles, you need to be
prepared for anything.

mmlore: The Viridian Sea's tribute to a
truly dedicated adventurer.
Tithe of the Tides.name: Tithe of the Tides
Tithe of the Tides.lore:
The Viridian Sea's tribute to a
truly dedicated adventurer.

mmlore: Strength and resolve are the only things
that endure in the Chillwind Tundra.
Frost Knight's Greaves.name: Frost Knight's Greaves
Frost Knight's Greaves.lore:
Strength and resolve are the only things
that endure in the Chillwind Tundra.

mmlore: Smoke swirls from within, and you gaze
a glimpse of that which is to come.
Pain. Suffering. But also, sometimes, hope.
Divination Orb.name: Divination Orb
Divination Orb.lore:
Smoke swirls from within, and you gaze
a glimpse of that which is to come.
Pain. Suffering. But also, sometimes, hope.

mmlore: Where have all the roamers gone?
The walkers yet to dream?
Their footsteps make valleys.
Their lifeblood forms the streams.
Old Ice Brogues.name: Old Ice Brogues
Old Ice Brogues.lore:
Where have all the roamers gone?
The walkers yet to dream?
Their footsteps make valleys.
Their lifeblood forms the streams.

mmlore: And lo, did Alric's spear pierce true.
And still his armor held, cracked and battered.
Heart of the Hero.name: Heart of the Hero
Heart of the Hero.lore:
And lo, did Alric's spear pierce true.
And still his armor held, cracked and battered.

mmlore: Even atop the mountain's peak,
none can be seen beyond the endless
sea of permafrost.
Crest of the Tundra.name: Crest of the Tundra
Crest of the Tundra.lore:
Even atop the mountain's peak,
none can be seen beyond the endless
sea of permafrost.

mmlore: Fast he hid from battle fierce,
An eye that deeply bled;
The Mountain Carver must escape
the bounty on his head.
Winter's Bounty (legs).name: Winter's Bounty
Winter's Bounty (legs).lore:
Fast he hid from battle fierce,
An eye that deeply bled;
The Mountain Carver must escape
the bounty on his head.

mmlore: As the scourge of battle beset the land,
the hammers turned to swords.
Ice was shaped to armor
as the giants stood for war.
Icicle Greaves.name: Icicle Greaves
Icicle Greaves.lore:
As the scourge of battle beset the land,
the hammers turned to swords.
Ice was shaped to armor
as the giants stood for war.

mmlore: Those whipping winds of winter shall extinguish all.
Only a warrior's will persists in the blizzard.
Hiemal Robes.name: Hiemal Robes
Hiemal Robes.lore:
Those whipping winds of winter shall extinguish all.
Only a warrior's will persists in the blizzard.

mmlore: The legendary folio, composed by ancient hands.
It tells of Giants long ago, who shaped these verdant lands.
Poet's Tome.name: Poet's Tome
Poet's Tome.lore:
The legendary folio, composed by ancient hands.
It tells of Giants long ago, who shaped these verdant lands.

mmlore: Near death a hazy rage did fall
and Alric breathed in gore.
With final strength the dagger fell.
The giant was no more.
Alric's Eyegouger.name: Alric's Eyegouger
Alric's Eyegouger.lore:
Near death a hazy rage did fall
and Alric breathed in gore.
With final strength the dagger fell.
The giant was no more.

mmlore: The bark of the Gateway Tree didn't have
the spacial abilities researchers had hoped
for. Instead, it made for quite the useful
boots, with a bite.
Bark of the Gateway Tree.name: Bark of the Gateway Tree
Bark of the Gateway Tree.lore:
The bark of the Gateway Tree didn't have
the spacial abilities researchers had hoped
for. Instead, it made for quite the useful
boots, with a bite.

mmlore: The magic swirling through the Congress overwhelmed
Tedac's body and he ascended into a new form.
The voice was pleased, then took control.
Shroud of the Lost.name: Shroud of the Lost
Shroud of the Lost.lore:
The magic swirling through the Congress overwhelmed
Tedac's body and he ascended into a new form.
The voice was pleased, then took control.

mmlore: Legends tell of a godly being that
forsook immortality in exchange for
a shell of unbreakable will.
The Godshell (chest).name: The Godshell
The Godshell (chest).lore:
Legends tell of a godly being that
forsook immortality in exchange for
a shell of unbreakable will.

mmlore: At the end, Eomen stood with his arms
wide, ready to embrace the magic sweeping
through the Forum. This was new ground
to break.
Eomen's Robes.name: Eomen's Robes
Eomen's Robes.lore:
At the end, Eomen stood with his arms
wide, ready to embrace the magic sweeping
through the Forum. This was new ground
to break.

mmlore: <dark_gray>Still not much for defense, but it sure
<dark_gray>doesn't fall apart as quickly.
Hardback Buckler.name: Hardback Buckler
Hardback Buckler.lore:
Still not much for defense, but it sure
doesn't fall apart as quickly.

mmlore: You peer into the blade and see only nothingness.
Something seems to draw you to gaze deeper...
The Empty Sabre.name: The Empty Sabre
The Empty Sabre.lore:
You peer into the blade and see only nothingness.
Something seems to draw you to gaze deeper...

mmlore: Nothing known can cut the True Ice, yet
this tooth slices through like a hot knife!
Surely this is of use to our archeologists!
Hrimnir's Incisor.name: Hrimnir's Incisor
Hrimnir's Incisor.lore:
Nothing known can cut the True Ice, yet
this tooth slices through like a hot knife!
Surely this is of use to our archeologists!

mmlore: <dark_gray>From nothing came colors to light the way.
<dark_gray>Too soon the path would be lost...
Replica Ex Nihilo.name: Replica Ex Nihilo
Replica Ex Nihilo.lore:
From nothing came colors to light the way.
Too soon the path would be lost...

mmlore: A lost spear - found buried deep below
the skin of a frozen Giant. Legend says
it was given to an ancient King, by a
Giant from beyond ice.
Titan Spear.name: Titan Spear
Titan Spear.lore:
A lost spear - found buried deep below
the skin of a frozen Giant. Legend says
it was given to an ancient King, by a
Giant from beyond ice.

mmlore: <dark_gray>So hungry... <obfuscated>Feed <obfuscated>me
Completely Harmless Tome.name: Completely Harmless Tome

mmlore: The start of eternity is the start
of life, in death they shall be
reborn as my eternity.
Creation (bow).name: Creation
Creation (bow).lore:
The start of eternity is the start
of life, in death they shall be
reborn as my eternity.

mmlore: Now, as the embrace of death finally
comes for me, I do understand why life
is so short. I have taken many lifetimes
to learn that sometimes it is better.
Rapture.name: Rapture
Rapture.lore:
Now, as the embrace of death finally
comes for me, I do understand why life
is so short. I have taken many lifetimes
to learn that sometimes it is better.

mmlore: I've seen their eyes peering through the Veil.
I don't know how to make them leave.
I barely know how to rip myself away either.
Departure (chest).name: Departure
Departure (chest).lore:
I've seen their eyes peering through the Veil.
I don't know how to make them leave.
I barely know how to rip myself away either.

mmlore: At the edge of reality bubbles a substance
known as Void. Perhaps it will offer me
more than the Veil ever had.
Consumption.name: Consumption
Consumption.lore:
At the edge of reality bubbles a substance
known as Void. Perhaps it will offer me
more than the Veil ever had.

mmlore: A whisper of wind on my skin.
The taste of salt spray on my lips.
The final gasp as the final end comes.
Never again. I have moved beyond mortal needs.
Transcendence.name: Transcendence
Transcendence.lore:
A whisper of wind on my skin.
The taste of salt spray on my lips.
The final gasp as the final end comes.
Never again. I have moved beyond mortal needs.

mmlore: An eternity, damned to the hellfires.
A soul, corrupted by their power.
Eternity.name: Eternity
Eternity.lore:
An eternity, damned to the hellfires.
A soul, corrupted by their power.

mmlore: When one seeks an absence of power
they may instead find where it all
has gone. Beyond that is a hatred I
have never known before...
Vehemence.name: Vehemence
Vehemence.lore:
When one seeks an absence of power
they may instead find where it all
has gone. Beyond that is a hatred I
have never known before...

mmlore: Flame, fury and relentless emotion entwined
since the dawn of life. Even so, death still
comes for all that lives.
Evening Star.name: Evening Star
Evening Star.lore:
Flame, fury and relentless emotion entwined
since the dawn of life. Even so, death still
comes for all that lives.

mmlore: None survived their fourth ride on Daredevil.
Daredevil didn't survive the Horseman's first.
Daredevil's Wake.name: Daredevil's Wake
Daredevil's Wake.lore:
None survived their fourth ride on Daredevil.
Daredevil didn't survive the Horseman's first.

mmlore: Bound to the wake of the
horse and his rider.
Bound Spirit's Tunic.name: Bound Spirit's Tunic
Bound Spirit's Tunic.lore:
Bound to the wake of the
horse and his rider.

mmlore: Power born from the souls of
the Horseman's victims.
Ghastcaller's Gunblade.name: Ghastcaller's Gunblade
Ghastcaller's Gunblade.lore:
Power born from the souls of
the Horseman's victims.

mmlore: You laugh at its defeat...
it laughs back.
Horseman's Head.name: Horseman's Head
Horseman's Head.lore:
You laugh at its defeat...
it laughs back.

mmlore: When one of the chains holding the island
broke, there was no better use for the
magic than to be worn.
Chains from Below the Waves.name: Chains from Below the Waves
Chains from Below the Waves.lore:
When one of the chains holding the island
broke, there was no better use for the
magic than to be worn.

mmlore: Tell me... is there an end?
The Eternal Mist.name: The Eternal Mist
The Eternal Mist.lore: Tell me... is there an end?

mmlore: A faint glow emerges from the carnage.
The fury of steel, silenced, but not forgotten.
Firefly's Rush.name: Firefly's Rush
Firefly's Rush.lore:
A faint glow emerges from the carnage.
The fury of steel, silenced, but not forgotten.

mmlore: Through the Black the Horseman rode.
In one hand, conquest.
The other, control.
Blackthread Whip.name: Blackthread Whip
Blackthread Whip.lore:
Through the Black the Horseman rode.
In one hand, conquest.
The other, control.

mmlore: The power of extreme experience,
manifest into a physical form.
Intellect Incarnate.name: Intellect Incarnate
Intellect Incarnate.lore:
The power of extreme experience,
manifest into a physical form.

mmlore: The power of total truth,
manifest into a physical form.
Salvation Incarnate.name: Salvation Incarnate
Salvation Incarnate.lore:
The power of total truth,
manifest into a physical form.

mmlore: "Perhaps, if not for the war, could I
have been free to wander?"
The girl had yet to roam nor explore,
alas consigned to a lone watchtower.
Salem's Regret.name: Salem's Regret
Salem's Regret.lore:
"Perhaps, if not for the war, could I
have been free to wander?"
The girl had yet to roam nor explore,
alas consigned to a lone watchtower.

mmlore: What was once Memory can again be made real.
A Kingdom lost, a blade found.
Dissolvi Ombre.name: Dissolvi Ombre
Dissolvi Ombre.lore:
What was once Memory can again be made real.
A Kingdom lost, a blade found.

mmlore: Kokytos, we see The Revelation of Alei.
The arc of history bends towards the will of your Prophets.
The sky will shatter soon enough -
and descend upon the sinful.
Alei's Arc.name: Alei's Arc
Alei's Arc.lore:
Kokytos, we see The Revelation of Alei.
The arc of history bends towards the will of your Prophets.
The sky will shatter soon enough -
and descend upon the sinful.

mmlore: Ransacking and defiling our temples... Is
nothing sacred to these sea rats?
Goddess' Sandals.name: Goddess' Sandals
Goddess' Sandals.lore:
Ransacking and defiling our temples... Is
nothing sacred to these sea rats?

mmlore: You stare into the hooded cloak...
infinite darkness stares back.
Elder's Cloak.name: Elder's Cloak
Elder's Cloak.lore:
You stare into the hooded cloak...
infinite darkness stares back.

mmlore: A gift brought to a queen of a golden land.
Unfortunately, it was her downfall.
Auric Tiara.name: Auric Tiara
Auric Tiara.lore:
A gift brought to a queen of a golden land.
Unfortunately, it was her downfall.

mmlore: Strands of dark mist cling to these, like
a last breath, still held within.
Varcosa's Breeches.name: Varcosa's Breeches
Varcosa's Breeches.lore:
Strands of dark mist cling to these, like
a last breath, still held within.

mmlore: The Black Mist's raiders have
come through the flood to
plunder your treasure and
spill your blood.
Treasured Rapier.name: Treasured Rapier
Treasured Rapier.lore:
The Black Mist's raiders have
come through the flood to
plunder your treasure and
spill your blood.

mmlore: The bloody edge draws from Beyond
this world. She is coming.
Unwavering Will.name: Unwavering Will
Unwavering Will.lore:
The bloody edge draws from Beyond
this world. She is coming.

mmlore: Crafted by royalty, wielded by heroes,
plundered by pirates.
Gilded Quiver.name: Gilded Quiver
Gilded Quiver.lore:
Crafted by royalty, wielded by heroes,
plundered by pirates.

mmlore: The chime swirls with flowing water,
playing a soft melody.
Water's Embrace.name: Water's Embrace
Water's Embrace.lore:
The chime swirls with flowing water,
playing a soft melody.

mmlore: A mere ageless existence doesn't prevent
one from passing through the veil.
Aberration's Amulet.name: Aberration's Amulet
Aberration's Amulet.lore:
A mere ageless existence doesn't prevent
one from passing through the veil.

mmlore: <dark_gray>The mist of rage clouds raider's eyes.
<dark_gray>Sink deeper still and claim your prize.
Marauder's Haze.name: Marauder's Haze
Marauder's Haze.lore:
The mist of rage clouds raider's eyes.
Sink deeper still and claim your prize.

mmlore: Varcosa's menacing visage lives
on eternally through you.
Ghost Captain's Visage.name: Ghost Captain's Visage
Ghost Captain's Visage.lore:
Varcosa's menacing visage lives
on eternally through you.

mmlore: A talon from the great ancient, lost
in the fury of battle with titans
of yore. With dying dragonbreath,
it radiates heat.
Talon of the Great Beast.name: Talon of the Great Beast
Talon of the Great Beast.lore:
A talon from the great ancient, lost
in the fury of battle with titans
of yore. With dying dragonbreath,
it radiates heat.

mmlore: Crafted from the cartilage of a Blackflame
corpse, infused by the cult presiding
over their bones.
Cartilage Cuirass.name: Cartilage Cuirass
Cartilage Cuirass.lore:
Crafted from the cartilage of a Blackflame
corpse, infused by the cult presiding
over their bones.

mmlore: The void creeps ever closer, shaping
what it cannot simply consume.
Failure of the Void.name: Failure of the Void
Failure of the Void.lore:
The void creeps ever closer, shaping
what it cannot simply consume.

mmlore: To speak for the dead, one must
learn their tongue.
Dragonbreath Repeater.name: Dragonbreath Repeater
Dragonbreath Repeater.lore:
To speak for the dead, one must
learn their tongue.

mmlore: Ancient horns adorn your visage.
Ancient jaws command your voice.
Osseous Mask.name: Osseous Mask
Osseous Mask.lore:
Ancient horns adorn your visage.
Ancient jaws command your voice.

mmlore: The last of the Blackflame have died
but their bones carry a great power that
feels strangely familiar.
Blackflame Remains.name: Blackflame Remains
Blackflame Remains.lore:
The last of the Blackflame have died
but their bones carry a great power that
feels strangely familiar.

mmlore: Ancient scales, scavenged by
the Blackflame cultists. What
terrible Beasts once wore
them proudly?
Dragonscale Greaves.name: Dragonscale Greaves
Dragonscale Greaves.lore:
Ancient scales, scavenged by
the Blackflame cultists. What
terrible Beasts once wore
them proudly?

mmlore: A metallic gauntlet, used by cultists as
a catalyst for eldritch rituals.
Blackflame Gauntlet.name: Blackflame Gauntlet
Blackflame Gauntlet.lore:
A metallic gauntlet, used by cultists as
a catalyst for eldritch rituals.

mmlore: It consumed the energy of the world
around it, slowly increasing its power.
Increasing its awareness.
Devouring Wind.name: Devouring Wind
Devouring Wind.lore:
It consumed the energy of the world
around it, slowly increasing its power.
Increasing its awareness.

mmlore: Tears would appear in this new world,
granting him vision of far off lands
that held more promise than his own. His
being yearned for them, but for those
tears in reality, he was too mighty to cross.
Winter's March.name: Winter's March
Winter's March.lore:
Tears would appear in this new world,
granting him vision of far off lands
that held more promise than his own. His
being yearned for them, but for those
tears in reality, he was too mighty to cross.

mmlore: After many aeons, a shock was felt
across existence. A power similar to
their world had burrowed its way in,
fleeing a realm in which it couldn't exist.
Scarlet Shift.name: Scarlet Shift
Scarlet Shift.lore:
After many aeons, a shock was felt
across existence. A power similar to
their world had burrowed its way in,
fleeing a realm in which it couldn't exist.

mmlore: When it finally comprehended its isolation,
it began to multiply. One mind. One soul.
One million strong.
Legionis.name: Legionis
Legionis.lore:
When it finally comprehended its isolation,
it began to multiply. One mind. One soul.
One million strong.

mmlore: It needed a name for itself. It needed
a name for them, but it knew not of the
concept of language.
Crown of Chains.name: Crown of Chains
Crown of Chains.lore:
It needed a name for itself. It needed
a name for them, but it knew not of the
concept of language.

mmlore: In time, it began to perceive that
which should not be understood. The
strands that bind the very fabric of
causality. It saw... Fate.
Mask of Cacophony.name: Mask of Cacophony
Mask of Cacophony.lore:
In time, it began to perceive that
which should not be understood. The
strands that bind the very fabric of
causality. It saw... Fate.

mmlore: Under the scarlet glow of this new world,
a single spark of life emerged.
Bloodmoon Chains.name: Bloodmoon Chains
Bloodmoon Chains.lore:
Under the scarlet glow of this new world,
a single spark of life emerged.

mmlore: The Fomori scoured the plane, seeking
the source of the tremor. The Danann
sought answers from the strands of
fate. But only one found the power
that laid silent in that grafted temple.
Rose Touch.name: Rose Touch
Rose Touch.lore:
The Fomori scoured the plane, seeking
the source of the tremor. The Danann
sought answers from the strands of
fate. But only one found the power
that laid silent in that grafted temple.

mmlore: All that remained was a way beyond.
A rift strong enough to allow passage.
A path to harmony.
Harmony's End.name: Harmony's End
Harmony's End.lore:
All that remained was a way beyond.
A rift strong enough to allow passage.
A path to harmony.

mmlore: Echoes danced in the vast abyss,
thoughts and ideas and dreams that
had long since died. From there, it
drew inspiration. In an ancient tongue,
they would be his Tuathan.
Demon's Scar (stone_hoe).name: Demon's Scar
Demon's Scar (stone_hoe).lore:
Echoes danced in the vast abyss,
thoughts and ideas and dreams that
had long since died. From there, it
drew inspiration. In an ancient tongue,
they would be his Tuathan.

mmlore: For time immemorial, worlds were born
from the entropic decay of that abyss
which lingers at the edge of one's fears.
Void Heart.name: Void Heart
Void Heart.lore:
For time immemorial, worlds were born
from the entropic decay of that abyss
which lingers at the edge of one's fears.

mmlore: From the endless abyss, a new world
tore asunder. Segregated. Isolated.
Dissonant.
Talaya's Decay.name: Talaya's Decay
Talaya's Decay.lore:
From the endless abyss, a new world
tore asunder. Segregated. Isolated.
Dissonant.

mmlore: The weapon hungered, split between the realms
of dissonance, only wielded by those who could
sate its endless appetite. A velvet haze shrouded
the gateway, accompanied by a frenzied, tarnished
legion. Only an ageless existence awaited them.
Nothing more, nothing less.
Ravenous Haze.name: Ravenous Haze
Ravenous Haze.lore:
The weapon hungered, split between the realms
of dissonance, only wielded by those who could
sate its endless appetite. A velvet haze shrouded
the gateway, accompanied by a frenzied, tarnished
legion. Only an ageless existence awaited them.
Nothing more, nothing less.

mmlore: <dark_gray>Kokytos bled into the reservoir below, blight
<dark_gray>filling the basin with darkness. He was held
<dark_gray>together only by the statue encasing him and
<dark_gray>the presence of power his masters could only
<dark_gray>dream of claiming for themselves.
Shell of Kokytos.name: Shell of Kokytos
Shell of Kokytos.lore:
Kokytos bled into the reservoir below, blight
filling the basin with darkness. He was held
together only by the statue encasing him and
the presence of power his masters could only
dream of claiming for themselves.

mmlore: <dark_gray>If you intend to make the long trek across
<dark_gray>the Chillwind continent, you'll need to bundle
<dark_gray>up in the warmest Linxi fur available.
Chillwind Overcoat.name: Chillwind Overcoat
Chillwind Overcoat.lore:
If you intend to make the long trek across
the Chillwind continent, you'll need to bundle
up in the warmest Linxi fur available.

mmlore: <dark_gray>This mechanized helmet seems to make water
<dark_gray>bubble when merely near it. Sometimes you
<dark_gray>can make out giggling inside one of the
<dark_gray>cooling pockets... How odd...
Steel Apparatus.name: Steel Apparatus
Steel Apparatus.lore:
This mechanized helmet seems to make water
bubble when merely near it. Sometimes you
can make out giggling inside one of the
cooling pockets... How odd...

mmlore: Tavern tales in Mistport speak of a storm that
appears once a century. They say the sea will
thirst for blood, and not even a ghost ship
could escape Her calls.
Thunder and Tempest.name: Thunder and Tempest
Thunder and Tempest.lore:
Tavern tales in Mistport speak of a storm that
appears once a century. They say the sea will
thirst for blood, and not even a ghost ship
could escape Her calls.

mmlore: "Great svartvlam sees us. Us, the empty ones
under them. Flames of ours must match theirs,
must be perfek. You understand, sah?"
Roaring Reverence.name: Roaring Reverence
Roaring Reverence.lore:
"Great svartvlam sees us. Us, the empty ones
under them. Flames of ours must match theirs,
must be perfek. You understand, sah?"

mmlore: <dark_gray>There are few sights more beloved than the
<dark_gray>rising of the cooling moon during a voyage across
<dark_gray>dunes of Ishnir. Within the cities, it is the setting
<dark_gray>of the moon that brings joy and heralds Mauta's rise.
Ishnir's Moon.name: Ishnir's Moon
Ishnir's Moon.lore:
There are few sights more beloved than the
rising of the cooling moon during a voyage across
dunes of Ishnir. Within the cities, it is the setting
of the moon that brings joy and heralds Mauta's rise.

mmlore: Not all who die are revived as revenants.
There are those who cling to the
familiarity of darkness, staring from
beyond an endless rest.
Sheol.name: Sheol
Sheol.lore:
Not all who die are revived as revenants.
There are those who cling to the
familiarity of darkness, staring from
beyond an endless rest.

mmlore: <dark_gray>Researchers are divided on if this is
<dark_gray>truly an eyeball. Either way, it makes for
<dark_gray>a very strange experience when thrown.
Hrimnir's Frosted Eye.name: Hrimnir's Frosted Eye
Hrimnir's Frosted Eye.lore:
Researchers are divided on if this is
truly an eyeball. Either way, it makes for
a very strange experience when thrown.

mmlore: Reality shifts, call for help.
Reality frays, help is woven.
Reality calls, power teases.
Blackthread Boots.name: Blackthread Boots
Blackthread Boots.lore:
Reality shifts, call for help.
Reality frays, help is woven.
Reality calls, power teases.

mmlore: When one passes, the tattoos fade
to the next, forever searching for
the vault deep within.
Phasing Chestplate.name: Phasing Chestplate
Phasing Chestplate.lore:
When one passes, the tattoos fade
to the next, forever searching for
the vault deep within.

mmlore: In the eternal twilight, the
pyre burns forever.
Nightpyre Chains.name: Nightpyre Chains
Nightpyre Chains.lore:
In the eternal twilight, the
pyre burns forever.

mmlore: Across aeons, the wind blows true.
Windborn Cape.name: Windborn Cape
Windborn Cape.lore: Across aeons, the wind blows true.

mmlore: The blessed sun and cleansing rains
fill the quiet air of the Rift.
Crown of the Rift.name: Crown of the Rift
Crown of the Rift.lore:
The blessed sun and cleansing rains
fill the quiet air of the Rift.

mmlore: Imbued with powers of old, from the bubbling
birth of earth, sea, and sky.
Primordial Skin.name: Primordial Skin
Primordial Skin.lore:
Imbued with powers of old, from the bubbling
birth of earth, sea, and sky.

mmlore: Time seems to twist around the very
magic this wand produces.
Riftbolt Stave.name: Riftbolt Stave
Riftbolt Stave.lore:
Time seems to twist around the very
magic this wand produces.

mmlore: The last stand of Isharist.
The wall shall stand forever.
Bastion of Isharist.name: Bastion of Isharist
Bastion of Isharist.lore:
The last stand of Isharist.
The wall shall stand forever.

mmlore: Time passes; the shadows loom.
Passing Shadows.name: Passing Shadows

mmlore: Not through frost nor drought nor tempest.
The spirits walk the space between.
Liminal Sabatons.name: Liminal Sabatons
Liminal Sabatons.lore:
Not through frost nor drought nor tempest.
The spirits walk the space between.

mmlore: The metal itself seems prepared to spring
into action at a breath, yet rests as if
it is all it has ever known.
Iridium Breastplate.name: Iridium Breastplate
Iridium Breastplate.lore:
The metal itself seems prepared to spring
into action at a breath, yet rests as if
it is all it has ever known.

mmlore: Patience - to hide and to wait.
That is the nature of the hunt.
Mask of the Interim.name: Mask of the Interim
Mask of the Interim.lore:
Patience - to hide and to wait.
That is the nature of the hunt.

mmlore: Unmoving, yet unrusted, there is an
elegance to tranquility earned. There
is a power to patience.
Iridium Greaves.name: Iridium Greaves
Iridium Greaves.lore:
Unmoving, yet unrusted, there is an
elegance to tranquility earned. There
is a power to patience.

mmlore: A requiem does not help the dead.
Rather, it comforts those that remain.
Chime of the Requiem.name: Chime of the Requiem
Chime of the Requiem.lore:
A requiem does not help the dead.
Rather, it comforts those that remain.

mmlore: A kaleidoscopic urn, holding the
ashes of time never passed.
Muranic Urn.name: Muranic Urn
Muranic Urn.lore:
A kaleidoscopic urn, holding the
ashes of time never passed.

mmlore: Words themselves can have the power
to hold eternity in its place.
That is Their right.
Rites of Eternity.name: Rites of Eternity
Rites of Eternity.lore:
Words themselves can have the power
to hold eternity in its place.
That is Their right.

mmlore: Hand in hand with Lust and Gluttony,
desires of man corrupt even the
honest soul.
Heart of Greed.name: Heart of Greed
Heart of Greed.lore:
Hand in hand with Lust and Gluttony,
desires of man corrupt even the
honest soul.

mmlore: One sin above the rest stands out
as the likely harbinger of the end.
Downfall.name: Downfall
Downfall.lore:
One sin above the rest stands out
as the likely harbinger of the end.

mmlore: To walk the sea floor is to be one
with the deep. Take heed, for the deep
is not merciful, and may not let go
of those in her grasp.
Seafloor's Sabatons.name: Seafloor's Sabatons
Seafloor's Sabatons.lore:
To walk the sea floor is to be one
with the deep. Take heed, for the deep
is not merciful, and may not let go
of those in her grasp.

mmlore: There is a saying about those in
power: They must watch every step,
lest they become a slave in a prison
of their own making.
Starboard Mail.name: Starboard Mail
Starboard Mail.lore:
There is a saying about those in
power: They must watch every step,
lest they become a slave in a prison
of their own making.

mmlore: Before thee crowned is the lord of the depths.
Bow, or be washed away.
Coral Crown.name: Coral Crown
Coral Crown.lore:
Before thee crowned is the lord of the depths.
Bow, or be washed away.

mmlore: Imbued with the power of the depths,
you can sense a strange, bubbling
breathing issuing from the vial.
Salazar's Breath.name: Salazar's Breath
Salazar's Breath.lore:
Imbued with the power of the depths,
you can sense a strange, bubbling
breathing issuing from the vial.

mmlore: The last remnants of a fallen crew,
swallowed by the beyond.
Shipwrecker's Sabre.name: Shipwrecker's Sabre
Shipwrecker's Sabre.lore:
The last remnants of a fallen crew,
swallowed by the beyond.

mmlore: The currents gather around the points of the lance.
Far away, an eye opens...
Thalassic Lance.name: Thalassic Lance
Thalassic Lance.lore:
The currents gather around the points of the lance.
Far away, an eye opens...

mmlore: Strike while the rocks are warm, for a
city must be built. A haven, void of war.
A gift to the world.
Adze of the Ebb.name: Adze of the Ebb
Adze of the Ebb.lore:
Strike while the rocks are warm, for a
city must be built. A haven, void of war.
A gift to the world.

mmlore: The tides cannot remain silent for
long. There is a disturbance in the
depths that must be purged.
Thrashing Tide.name: Thrashing Tide
Thrashing Tide.lore:
The tides cannot remain silent for
long. There is a disturbance in the
depths that must be purged.

mmlore: Alone, unstoked. Still the fires
burned... waiting...
Forlorn Flames.name: Forlorn Flames
Forlorn Flames.lore:
Alone, unstoked. Still the fires
burned... waiting...

mmlore: He spilled the blood.
For his sacrifice, his dreams were actualized.
So too were his nightmares.
Aspiration.name: Aspiration
Aspiration.lore:
He spilled the blood.
For his sacrifice, his dreams were actualized.
So too were his nightmares.

mmlore: What horrors did those miners unearth?
What drove them to inherit the Scourge?
I shudder at what lies below.
Fleshmaddened Roots.name: Fleshmaddened Roots
Fleshmaddened Roots.lore:
What horrors did those miners unearth?
What drove them to inherit the Scourge?
I shudder at what lies below.

mmlore: Some were forged in the flames.
Those with power were born in it.
Those beyond were there when the flames were lit.
Flameborn Runeplate.name: Flameborn Runeplate
Flameborn Runeplate.lore:
Some were forged in the flames.
Those with power were born in it.
Those beyond were there when the flames were lit.

mmlore: A heat so immense that it could
command the other flames.
Incendiary Inferno.name: Incendiary Inferno
Incendiary Inferno.lore:
A heat so immense that it could
command the other flames.

mmlore: Rivers of fire beget rivers of blood -
to bear witness to these cursed visions
must drive the sane to madness.
Phlegethon Visage.name: Phlegethon Visage
Phlegethon Visage.lore:
Rivers of fire beget rivers of blood -
to bear witness to these cursed visions
must drive the sane to madness.

mmlore: Hard labor should be rewarded;
here, the reward was a swift death.
Laborious Chains.name: Laborious Chains
Laborious Chains.lore:
Hard labor should be rewarded;
here, the reward was a swift death.

mmlore: With body and spirit united in Mind,
lunacy overtook the temple.
Wit's End.name: Wit's End
Wit's End.lore:
With body and spirit united in Mind,
lunacy overtook the temple.

mmlore: Your alchemical supplies seem to react
strangely with the contents of this fleshy
vial, creating hypnotic displays when
impacting the ground.
Heartbeat Decanter.name: Heartbeat Decanter
Heartbeat Decanter.lore:
Your alchemical supplies seem to react
strangely with the contents of this fleshy
vial, creating hypnotic displays when
impacting the ground.

mmlore: Its form was lost in the tranformation,
but perhaps this monstrosity once
held beauty in its maw.
Putrid Maw.name: Putrid Maw
Putrid Maw.lore:
Its form was lost in the tranformation,
but perhaps this monstrosity once
held beauty in its maw.

mmlore: Only a dribble was needed, but
why waste a fine artery?
Bloodletter's Dagger.name: Bloodletter's Dagger
Bloodletter's Dagger.lore:
Only a dribble was needed, but
why waste a fine artery?

mmlore: In the end, they were cut down one by one...
a worthy song for such traitors.
Blasphemer's Sickle.name: Blasphemer's Sickle
Blasphemer's Sickle.lore:
In the end, they were cut down one by one...
a worthy song for such traitors.

mmlore: Fresh cursestone rests affixed to the stave.
A miner's labor earned it, and a miner's
madness wields it.
Malebolge Stave.name: Malebolge Stave
Malebolge Stave.lore:
Fresh cursestone rests affixed to the stave.
A miner's labor earned it, and a miner's
madness wields it.

mmlore: A mighty axe, swung to chop a single
branch from the Tree of Life.
Entcrusher (axe).name: Entcrusher
Entcrusher (axe).lore:
A mighty axe, swung to chop a single
branch from the Tree of Life.

mmlore: You feel a prick, and see your blood
running through the veins of the machinery.
What madman built these?
Mechanized Treads.name: Mechanized Treads
Mechanized Treads.lore:
You feel a prick, and see your blood
running through the veins of the machinery.
What madman built these?

mmlore: The hardest creatures to study are
the ones best protected by the natives.
Poacher's Rifle.name: Poacher's Rifle
Poacher's Rifle.lore:
The hardest creatures to study are
the ones best protected by the natives.

mmlore: Visions of the future leak from
every shimmering chain link.
Crown of Unseen Knowledge.name: Crown of Unseen Knowledge
Crown of Unseen Knowledge.lore:
Visions of the future leak from
every shimmering chain link.

mmlore: The cracked, ancient bronze is broken
by one massive spike. Its fate seems
fixed in history.
Quercus Helm.name: Quercus Helm
Quercus Helm.lore:
The cracked, ancient bronze is broken
by one massive spike. Its fate seems
fixed in history.

mmlore: While scholars are known for their peaceful
research, the tomes they study don't
tend to be as polite.
Archivist's Legguards.name: Archivist's Legguards
Archivist's Legguards.lore:
While scholars are known for their peaceful
research, the tomes they study don't
tend to be as polite.

mmlore: Void itself is captured within the vial.
With this discovery, the Congress can
<dark_gray>now push toward greater discoveries.
Nihilo Proof.name: Nihilo Proof
Nihilo Proof.lore:
Void itself is captured within the vial.
With this discovery, the Congress can
now push toward greater discoveries.

mmlore: The vial smells sickeningly sweet
even from a distance. The outside
is coated in warning labels... but
how dangerous could it be?
Saccharine Sample.name: Saccharine Sample
Saccharine Sample.lore:
The vial smells sickeningly sweet
even from a distance. The outside
is coated in warning labels... but
how dangerous could it be?

mmlore: The razor's edge of Ixume's own arrows.
They will tear through flesh.
Flintcatcher's Edge.name: Flintcatcher's Edge
Flintcatcher's Edge.lore:
The razor's edge of Ixume's own arrows.
They will tear through flesh.

mmlore: There is a darkness creeping in
at the edges of the Conscriptorium.
What lies beyond?
Drop of Void.name: Drop of Void
Drop of Void.lore:
There is a darkness creeping in
at the edges of the Conscriptorium.
What lies beyond?

mmlore: Glyphs glisten across the surface,
promising the safety of home, even
when far from it.
Homestead.name: Homestead
Homestead.lore:
Glyphs glisten across the surface,
promising the safety of home, even
when far from it.

mmlore: The metal is covered in notches, where thousands
of swords have struck - then shattered into
fragments of pure magic.
Magistruct Breaker.name: Magistruct Breaker
Magistruct Breaker.lore:
The metal is covered in notches, where thousands
of swords have struck - then shattered into
fragments of pure magic.

mmlore: <dark_gray>The researchers were always sad to see
a plant put down. Mostly because
euthanasia required being a bit too
close for comfort.
Wilting Agent.name: Wilting Agent
Wilting Agent.lore:
The researchers were always sad to see
a plant put down. Mostly because
euthanasia required being a bit too
close for comfort.

mmlore: Behind the veil, there
is only darkness.
Erebus.name: Erebus
Erebus.lore:
Behind the veil, there
is only darkness.

mmlore: Woven from a few thousand locusts -
it itches quite a bit.
Locust's Sandals.name: Locust's Sandals
Locust's Sandals.lore:
Woven from a few thousand locusts -
it itches quite a bit.

mmlore: It emanates a foul stench - hopefully
to keep the scarabs away.
Scarab's Bane.name: Scarab's Bane
Scarab's Bane.lore:
It emanates a foul stench - hopefully
to keep the scarabs away.

mmlore: Skirt along the fire's rim, and you shall
know its heat. Familiarize yourself and
draw ever closer to it.
Iza's Scales.name: Iza's Scales
Iza's Scales.lore:
Skirt along the fire's rim, and you shall
know its heat. Familiarize yourself and
draw ever closer to it.

mmlore: Let's hope you don't end up
like this poor fellow.
Sacrifice's Scalp.name: Sacrifice's Scalp
Sacrifice's Scalp.lore:
Let's hope you don't end up
like this poor fellow.

mmlore: Drain the life of those around you,
and you shall stand alone. Isolation
breeds enlightenment if you can bear
the weight of the results.
Wadah's Solitude.name: Wadah's Solitude
Wadah's Solitude.lore:
Drain the life of those around you,
and you shall stand alone. Isolation
breeds enlightenment if you can bear
the weight of the results.

mmlore: Harden thy form, and slow thy movement.
Only then shall you become one with
the tortoise.
Ammi's Embrace.name: Ammi's Embrace
Ammi's Embrace.lore:
Harden thy form, and slow thy movement.
Only then shall you become one with
the tortoise.

mmlore: The golden jar appears to be smashed in
frustration, but it holds your alchemical
supplies as well as any other vessel.
Cracked Canopic.name: Cracked Canopic
Cracked Canopic.lore:
The golden jar appears to be smashed in
frustration, but it holds your alchemical
supplies as well as any other vessel.

mmlore: For honor! For glory! For
the Gem, Al Malakut!
Dutiful Blade.name: Dutiful Blade
Dutiful Blade.lore:
For honor! For glory! For
the Gem, Al Malakut!

mmlore: From clay, you were forged.
From the ashes, you rise anew.
Necromancer's Sigil.name: Necromancer's Sigil
Necromancer's Sigil.lore:
From clay, you were forged.
From the ashes, you rise anew.

mmlore: Sun soon rose on a day when the
desert's heart was broken.
Sahra Ib.name: Sahra Ib
Sahra Ib.lore:
Sun soon rose on a day when the
desert's heart was broken.

mmlore: Strength lies not only with brute force,
but the ability to control it. Such is
the wisdom of the Son of Flame.
Akam's Ferocity.name: Akam's Ferocity
Akam's Ferocity.lore:
Strength lies not only with brute force,
but the ability to control it. Such is
the wisdom of the Son of Flame.

mmlore: Necrosis is but the beginning, a soul must
be severed to attain new life.
Soulreaper.name: Soulreaper
Soulreaper.lore:
Necrosis is but the beginning, a soul must
be severed to attain new life.

mmlore: Ishnirian fables tell of warriors whose pace
never slowed, unwavering even through
lakes of fire or the hottest coals.
Trailblazer.name: Trailblazer
Trailblazer.lore:
Ishnirian fables tell of warriors whose pace
never slowed, unwavering even through
lakes of fire or the hottest coals.

mmlore: Even should all your allies turn away,
and your kingdom forsake you as lost...
you still stand. As resolute and unyielding
as the ice beneath your feet.
Permafrost Bastion.name: Permafrost Bastion
Permafrost Bastion.lore:
Even should all your allies turn away,
and your kingdom forsake you as lost...
you still stand. As resolute and unyielding
as the ice beneath your feet.

mmlore: The wrath of the Pharaohs arrive like
the rising of the morning sun...
Harsh, absolute, and uncaring for the
lives of those beneath them.
Break of Dawn.name: Break of Dawn
Break of Dawn.lore:
The wrath of the Pharaohs arrive like
the rising of the morning sun...
Harsh, absolute, and uncaring for the
lives of those beneath them.

mmlore: "Benn Versterk Staadmet..." The highest
form of reverence displayed within
the city... An offering made final...
Cage of Worship.name: Cage of Worship
Cage of Worship.lore:
"Benn Versterk Staadmet..." The highest
form of reverence displayed within
the city... An offering made final...

mmlore: Equipment of those who fell in the mines
was retrieved posthaste so digging would
continue. Life was cheap. Equipment was not.
Basaltic Hardhat.name: Basaltic Hardhat
Basaltic Hardhat.lore:
Equipment of those who fell in the mines
was retrieved posthaste so digging would
continue. Life was cheap. Equipment was not.

mmlore: A cap forged from seaborn mushrooms,
adopting and sharing the resilience of the
spires with its wearer.
Shroomshelf Shako.name: Shroomshelf Shako
Shroomshelf Shako.lore:
A cap forged from seaborn mushrooms,
adopting and sharing the resilience of the
spires with its wearer.

mmlore: Only the most daring sailors risk a voyage through
uncharted waters. The ocean is a cruel mistress,
and few escape her fury unscathed.
Leviathan's Fang.name: Leviathan's Fang
Leviathan's Fang.lore:
Only the most daring sailors risk a voyage through
uncharted waters. The ocean is a cruel mistress,
and few escape her fury unscathed.

mmlore: Countless sandstorms have weathered
away the earth itself, the ashen plumes
granting the steel a constitution solely
unique to this region's minerals.
Ashensteel Buckler.name: Ashensteel Buckler
Ashensteel Buckler.lore:
Countless sandstorms have weathered
away the earth itself, the ashen plumes
granting the steel a constitution solely
unique to this region's minerals.

mmlore: Impeccable precision is required when
unearthing ancient artifacts. Typical
tools cannot break through the True Ice
beneath the tundra however.
Archeologist's Hammer.name: Archeologist's Hammer
Archeologist's Hammer.lore:
Impeccable precision is required when
unearthing ancient artifacts. Typical
tools cannot break through the True Ice
beneath the tundra however.

mmlore: Typically worn by students training
their focus, the shoes provide an
exponential amplification of magic
when worn by a master.
Spellbinder's Slippers.name: Spellbinder's Slippers
Spellbinder's Slippers.lore:
Typically worn by students training
their focus, the shoes provide an
exponential amplification of magic
when worn by a master.

mmlore: Shroud your body in the
cover of crackling coals.
Embers of the Hearth.name: Embers of the Hearth
Embers of the Hearth.lore:
Shroud your body in the
cover of crackling coals.

mmlore: A chill grips your heart and lungs.
Frost lingers on your breath.
Despite the discomfort, you feel refreshed.
True Ice Shroud.name: True Ice Shroud
True Ice Shroud.lore:
A chill grips your heart and lungs.
Frost lingers on your breath.
Despite the discomfort, you feel refreshed.

mmlore: Myriad lost this chestplate in a
bet with the Casino owner.
Myriad's Embrace.name: Myriad's Embrace
Myriad's Embrace.lore:
Myriad lost this chestplate in a
bet with the Casino owner.

mmlore: An incredible feat of arcane engineering,
with springs infused with kinetic magic.
It's hard to believe that a student crafted it...
Springloaded Gadget.name: Springloaded Gadget
Springloaded Gadget.lore:
An incredible feat of arcane engineering,
with springs infused with kinetic magic.
It's hard to believe that a student crafted it...

mmlore: Some mages become hunters themselves.
The trophies are a twisted reminder
of Chillwind's current hierarchy.
Mage Hunter's Mask.name: Mage Hunter's Mask
Mage Hunter's Mask.lore:
Some mages become hunters themselves.
The trophies are a twisted reminder
of Chillwind's current hierarchy.

mmlore: Once owned by a professor of wind magic,
the greaves were lost in a levitation mishap,
then found in a separate one.
Galemage's Greaves.name: Galemage's Greaves
Galemage's Greaves.lore:
Once owned by a professor of wind magic,
the greaves were lost in a levitation mishap,
then found in a separate one.

mmlore: Although fashioned from local wolves,
the pelt bears a distinctly foreign style.
Wearing it, you feel unstoppable.
Greymane Pelt.name: Greymane Pelt
Greymane Pelt.lore:
Although fashioned from local wolves,
the pelt bears a distinctly foreign style.
Wearing it, you feel unstoppable.

mmlore: Arcane flames dance off of the steel,
burning with intensity but emitting
no heat. The blade stays lit even when
plunged into the sea.
Amaranth Blade.name: Amaranth Blade
Amaranth Blade.lore:
Arcane flames dance off of the steel,
burning with intensity but emitting
no heat. The blade stays lit even when
plunged into the sea.

mmlore: Unearthed from a nearby dig site, the
frigid permafrost has been shaped into
a more manageable weapon.
True Ice Splinter.name: True Ice Splinter
True Ice Splinter.lore:
Unearthed from a nearby dig site, the
frigid permafrost has been shaped into
a more manageable weapon.

mmlore: The wood of the Wispleaf Tree offers
a familiar protection from the cold.
A wreath adorns the shield, frosted with
the sharp ice of winter.
Wispleaf Wall.name: Wispleaf Wall
Wispleaf Wall.lore:
The wood of the Wispleaf Tree offers
a familiar protection from the cold.
A wreath adorns the shield, frosted with
the sharp ice of winter.

mmlore: Carved from a fallen branch,
it whispers - persist.
Wispleaf Ward.name: Wispleaf Ward
Wispleaf Ward.lore:
Carved from a fallen branch,
it whispers - persist.

mmlore: You feel refreshed by the faint
scent of nectar.
Branch of Life.name: Branch of Life
Branch of Life.lore:
You feel refreshed by the faint
scent of nectar.

mmlore: The scythe, relinquished through
many tavern gambles, seems to bring
fortune to its owner... until their
luck runs out.
Gambler's Cane.name: Gambler's Cane
Gambler's Cane.lore:
The scythe, relinquished through
many tavern gambles, seems to bring
fortune to its owner... until their
luck runs out.

mmlore: A conduit for the wild
power of lightning.
Thunderstorm Staff.name: Thunderstorm Staff
Thunderstorm Staff.lore:
A conduit for the wild
power of lightning.

mmlore: A hammer with the might
to sculpt the earth.
Wrath of the Mountains.name: Wrath of the Mountains
Wrath of the Mountains.lore:
A hammer with the might
to sculpt the earth.

mmlore: If I had a nickel for every being that
was unwillingly granted immortality
and praised as a new god, I'd
have two nickels. Which isn't a lot,
but it's weird it happened twice.
Boots of Monshee.name: Boots of Monshee
Boots of Monshee.lore:
If I had a nickel for every being that
was unwillingly granted immortality
and praised as a new god, I'd
have two nickels. Which isn't a lot,
but it's weird it happened twice.

mmlore: Protect the Crown, and defend thy land.
Such is the oath of the Chillwind soldiers.
Frostguard Sabatons.name: Frostguard Sabatons
Frostguard Sabatons.lore:
Protect the Crown, and defend thy land.
Such is the oath of the Chillwind soldiers.

mmlore: Step by step, the endless snow will
sap your energy. Even the mighty
require some support.
Chillwind Treads.name: Chillwind Treads
Chillwind Treads.lore:
Step by step, the endless snow will
sap your energy. Even the mighty
require some support.

mmlore: When the storm clears,
all is washed away.
Fury of the Storm.name: Fury of the Storm
Fury of the Storm.lore:
When the storm clears,
all is washed away.

mmlore: To watch the oasis bloom and wither and bloom again.
The patience of Ammi blesses the Ishnir dunes.
Oasis Mail.name: Oasis Mail
Oasis Mail.lore:
To watch the oasis bloom and wither and bloom again.
The patience of Ammi blesses the Ishnir dunes.

mmlore: Patterns in the cloth depict
three crowns in a regal gold
thread. Syl. Ka. Den.
Robes of the Pharaoh.name: Robes of the Pharaoh
Robes of the Pharaoh.lore:
Patterns in the cloth depict
three crowns in a regal gold
thread. Syl. Ka. Den.

mmlore: The ethereal shots of the rifle seem to
phase through this world, into the beyond.
Phantom Flintlock.name: Phantom Flintlock
Phantom Flintlock.lore:
The ethereal shots of the rifle seem to
phase through this world, into the beyond.

mmlore: Blazing flames dance in the
shape of a crown.
Crown of Flames.name: Crown of Flames
Crown of Flames.lore:
Blazing flames dance in the
shape of a crown.

mmlore: Prep the deck and raise the sails
A new day rises, adventure hails.
Waverider's Cap.name: Waverider's Cap
Waverider's Cap.lore:
Prep the deck and raise the sails
A new day rises, adventure hails.

mmlore: A pirate worth his salt knows that metal
garments have no place on a ship. The sea
water will weather them to rust and the
waves will drag them below.
Cannonball Chains.name: Cannonball Chains
Cannonball Chains.lore:
A pirate worth his salt knows that metal
garments have no place on a ship. The sea
water will weather them to rust and the
waves will drag them below.

mmlore: A ghostly howl rings through the air -
a chime that signals all to be wary.
Ethereal Greaves.name: Ethereal Greaves
Ethereal Greaves.lore:
A ghostly howl rings through the air -
a chime that signals all to be wary.

mmlore: Nothing lost, nothing gained.
Jorts of Monshee.name: Jorts of Monshee

mmlore: Mauta's blessing be upon the rolling dunes
of Ishnir. From the mesa above to the canyons
below, the warmth of the Goddess is felt
by all her creatures.
Sands of Ishnir.name: Sands of Ishnir
Sands of Ishnir.lore:
Mauta's blessing be upon the rolling dunes
of Ishnir. From the mesa above to the canyons
below, the warmth of the Goddess is felt
by all her creatures.

mmlore: The blade's edge is stained a reddish-brown
copper. The blood still left is worn
as a trophy.
Mage Hunter's Blade.name: Mage Hunter's Blade
Mage Hunter's Blade.lore:
The blade's edge is stained a reddish-brown
copper. The blood still left is worn
as a trophy.

mmlore: Vitality flourishes despite the oppressive
heat. The gift of Iza is no mirage.
Oasis Scimitar.name: Oasis Scimitar
Oasis Scimitar.lore:
Vitality flourishes despite the oppressive
heat. The gift of Iza is no mirage.

mmlore: This shield is sculpted from
the ice of the permafrost,
forever crystalline, never
again to flow.
Icicle's Bulwark.name: Icicle's Bulwark
Icicle's Bulwark.lore:
This shield is sculpted from
the ice of the permafrost,
forever crystalline, never
again to flow.

mmlore: Donned by the royal guard of the Den dynasty.
Those struck by the blade are said to disappear
into the endless sands of time.
Sandblaster.name: Sandblaster
Sandblaster.lore:
Donned by the royal guard of the Den dynasty.
Those struck by the blade are said to disappear
into the endless sands of time.

mmlore: Your blood. Your bones. Your strength.
It all shall go to serve the Pharaohs.
This is what happens when filth defies
the chosen.
Molta's Labor.name: Molta's Labor
Molta's Labor.lore:
Your blood. Your bones. Your strength.
It all shall go to serve the Pharaohs.
This is what happens when filth defies
the chosen.

mmlore: Death's touch is a cold one.
Ice Reaper.name: Ice Reaper
Ice Reaper.lore: Death's touch is a cold one.

mmlore: A mythical relic of the sea.
Hydraal.name: Hydraal
Hydraal.lore: A mythical relic of the sea.

mmlore: Even the dead fall to Winter's wrath.
Blizzard's Rage.name: Blizzard's Rage
Blizzard's Rage.lore: Even the dead fall to Winter's wrath.

mmlore: A path to follow; a shackle to bind.
The boots will radiate with the energy
of a thousand stars.
Boots of Alutana.name: Boots of Alutana
Boots of Alutana.lore:
A path to follow; a shackle to bind.
The boots will radiate with the energy
of a thousand stars.

mmlore: Through sea and snow the stars have guided us.
In the distance, I see a gleaming visage.
The moonlight glows familiar.
Nightsky Treads.name: Nightsky Treads
Nightsky Treads.lore:
Through sea and snow the stars have guided us.
In the distance, I see a gleaming visage.
The moonlight glows familiar.

mmlore: No chains will bind the Prophet's
wings. No shadows will block her light.
Alutana was surely sent to speak for
the Stars above.
Wings of Alutana.name: Wings of Alutana
Wings of Alutana.lore:
No chains will bind the Prophet's
wings. No shadows will block her light.
Alutana was surely sent to speak for
the Stars above.

mmlore: Here too, whispers from Above have shown
themselves. Be it by stars or by moon,
the sky must still shatter.
Stargazer's Wrap.name: Stargazer's Wrap
Stargazer's Wrap.lore:
Here too, whispers from Above have shown
themselves. Be it by stars or by moon,
the sky must still shatter.

mmlore: Your eyes gleam with a cold determination.
A faint light reveals the path forward.
Lunar Great Helm.name: Lunar Great Helm
Lunar Great Helm.lore:
Your eyes gleam with a cold determination.
A faint light reveals the path forward.

mmlore: Without a Prophet, how will His
Light radiate beyond the snow? A
vessel must be built for the Lord's
word to break free.
Brightbind.name: Brightbind
Brightbind.lore:
Without a Prophet, how will His
Light radiate beyond the snow? A
vessel must be built for the Lord's
word to break free.

mmlore: The icy jar is filled with a blight from
beyond the Veil. It glows with ominous
starlight, tempting you to crack it open.
Celestial Ooze.name: Celestial Ooze
Celestial Ooze.lore:
The icy jar is filled with a blight from
beyond the Veil. It glows with ominous
starlight, tempting you to crack it open.

mmlore: Bathed in the pools of Kokytos beneath the
ice, the next Prophet waits. With His breath,
the binds of frost and sky will shatter.
His word will be revealed.
Chainbreaker's Blight.name: Chainbreaker's Blight
Chainbreaker's Blight.lore:
Bathed in the pools of Kokytos beneath the
ice, the next Prophet waits. With His breath,
the binds of frost and sky will shatter.
His word will be revealed.

mmlore: Beyond. Calls to that Light - explore!
Exposed. Her light - now that of lore.
Weeping - Light dropped on that shore.
Tear of the Moon.name: Tear of the Moon
Tear of the Moon.lore:
Beyond. Calls to that Light - explore!
Exposed. Her light - now that of lore.
Weeping - Light dropped on that shore.

mmlore: From a message in a moonbeam,
the Lord's true name was revealed.
Engraved into the ice blade:
Kokytos.
Moonbeam Dagger.name: Moonbeam Dagger
Moonbeam Dagger.lore:
From a message in a moonbeam,
the Lord's true name was revealed.
Engraved into the ice blade:
Kokytos.

mmlore: <dark_gray>A gift from our Lord On High
<dark_gray>rests below. Break through the
<dark_gray>ice and bask in the light of eternity.
<dark_gray>As you sink, you soon too will see.
Shattershine.name: Shattershine
Shattershine.lore:
A gift from our Lord On High
rests below. Break through the
ice and bask in the light of eternity.
As you sink, you soon too will see.

mmlore: Crack the sky with a scattered beam.
Mirrorshard Scythe.name: Mirrorshard Scythe
Mirrorshard Scythe.lore: Crack the sky with a scattered beam.

mmlore: Once enshrined in the Frostgate crypts,
the Frost Moon recovered the blade.
A new Prophet must be protected in the
same manner as the Old.
Moon's Judgment.name: Moon's Judgment
Moon's Judgment.lore:
Once enshrined in the Frostgate crypts,
the Frost Moon recovered the blade.
A new Prophet must be protected in the
same manner as the Old.

mmlore: The axe of the empire's executioner.
It delivers justice... or a political
message.
Silverweight Axe.name: Silverweight Axe
Silverweight Axe.lore:
The axe of the empire's executioner.
It delivers justice... or a political
message.

mmlore: In the end, Salazar chose to flee rather
than face his folly. The great empire
of Viridia sunk beneath the waves,
drowned forevermore.
Salazar's Spats.name: Salazar's Spats
Salazar's Spats.lore:
In the end, Salazar chose to flee rather
than face his folly. The great empire
of Viridia sunk beneath the waves,
drowned forevermore.

mmlore: A bow that draws on the mind for
ammunition. Each shot requires
extensive willpower.
Aperion.name: Aperion
Aperion.lore:
A bow that draws on the mind for
ammunition. Each shot requires
extensive willpower.

mmlore: The Leafveil was a magic force used to shield
the Viridian from many dangers. It has since
turned on its creator.
Leafveil Shroud.name: Leafveil Shroud
Leafveil Shroud.lore:
The Leafveil was a magic force used to shield
the Viridian from many dangers. It has since
turned on its creator.

mmlore: With a thunderous crash of salt
and sea, the archives of Viridis
were lost to the waves. The seafoam
is stained with ink.
Seafoam Cap.name: Seafoam Cap
Seafoam Cap.lore:
With a thunderous crash of salt
and sea, the archives of Viridis
were lost to the waves. The seafoam
is stained with ink.

mmlore: Knowledge flowed in the Viridian Empire
like water. When the collapse came, the
water would carry it all away.
Viridis Construct.name: Viridis Construct
Viridis Construct.lore:
Knowledge flowed in the Viridian Empire
like water. When the collapse came, the
water would carry it all away.

mmlore: Your hands start to turn a sickly green
as you grip the vial. Best to stay out of
<dark_gray>the splash radius.
Gillman Mutagen.name: Gillman Mutagen
Gillman Mutagen.lore:
Your hands start to turn a sickly green
as you grip the vial. Best to stay out of
the splash radius.

mmlore: The greatest power of man is to write
their own history. The greatest tragedy
is for those words to be washed away
by uncaring waves.
Quill of the Emperor.name: Quill of the Emperor
Quill of the Emperor.lore:
The greatest power of man is to write
their own history. The greatest tragedy
is for those words to be washed away
by uncaring waves.

mmlore: The weapon itself is living. A
symbiotic relationship between
biology and metallurgy.
Metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
Metamorphosis.lore:
The weapon itself is living. A
symbiotic relationship between
biology and metallurgy.

mmlore: Enhanced to the point of brilliant
precision. Unfortunately, that precision
has a price.
Aquatic Adze.name: Aquatic Adze
Aquatic Adze.lore:
Enhanced to the point of brilliant
precision. Unfortunately, that precision
